'''House Depon''' was a [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house that was a rival of the Kuati family [[House Andrim]]. At some point during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], House Adrim sent a representative to the [[Belgaroth system/Legends|Belgaroth system]], to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on weapons tests that were to be performed by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] ''[[Burning Vengeance]]'' and [[Legacy (Star Destroyer)|''Legacy'']]. However, House Depon secretly [[Death/Legends|murdered]] House Andrim's agent and replaced the operative with an impersonator.<ref name="CCW" />
